Definition: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to smelt, refine, test; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to smelt, refine; 1a2) to test; 1a3) to test (and prove true); 1a4) smelter, refiner, goldsmith (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be refined; 1c) (Piel) to be a refiner; 1c1) refiner (participle)
